title: Wednesday Apple Rumors: Apple May Refresh Several Devices in 2018 – USAonline.press 🇺🇸 Breaking News
text:
TV News
Leading the Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) rumor mill today is talk of many device refreshes in 2018 . 2018 Refresh: A new rumor claims that Apple is planning to refresh loads of devices in 2018, reports MacRumors. According to this rumor, the company is planning to release new or refreshed versions for the iPhone, iPad, Mac mini, MacBook Pro, iMac, and Apple Watch.
